claim_boundary: Exact 65-dimensional lower bounds for the preregistered coarse source-local hinge families, and hence their refinements. This rejects eligibility under the frozen 64-parameter transport cap; it does not prove functional nonmembership, rule out other operators, or decide MAX11.
